info.title: forgekit
info.description: CLI toolkit for game development. Audits Unity projects for orphan assets, unoptimized textures and duplicate files, and can fail a CI pipeline.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: forgekit - developer tools for game projects

commands.name: assetaudit
commands.description: Audit a Unity project's assets: orphans, unoptimized textures and duplicates.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the Unity project root (the folder containing Assets/ and ProjectSettings/).

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write the report to (json or markdown formats only).

options.name: --format
options.description: console, json or markdown. Inferred from the --output extension when omitted; defaults to console.

options.name: --max-texture-size
options.description: Textures with a larger max size are reported. [default: 2048]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Path fragment of assets to ignore in all checks, e.g. Assets/ThirdParty/. Ignored assets still count as references. Repeatable.

options.name: --severity-threshold
options.description: Only show findings at or above this level: info, warning or error. Defaults to info.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any finding is at or above this level: warning or error.
